This data set contains the eight (8) scans collected to document the effects of dismantling the Perrenoud Homestead due to safety concerns. This data is the fifth of five data sets. The data was collected with the Z+F 5010X by the Capture2Preserve Team on July 25 201. This was the final day of dismantling the homestead. The data was processed with Laser Control v. 8.9.
